title: Gerald Schuster Associate Professor of Business Administration
bio: Winner of the Best Paper Award at the 2022 MIT Asia Conference in Accounting for "Communicating Corporate Culture in Labor Markets: Evidence from Job Postings" with Tianshuo Shi and Yuan Zou.

He currently teaches Business Analysis and Valuation (BAV) in the MBA elective curriculum. Professor Pacelli’s research examines how information flows shape the decisions of market participants, with interests spanning information intermediaries, corporate misconduct, and labor markets.
